description: Audio quality canon for background music, sound effects, and mixed audio.

quality_dimensions.name: Sync Accuracy
quality_dimensions.description: Audio must be synchronized with corresponding visual events.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Audio events align with visual within +/- 40ms.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Visible lip-sync mismatch or offset sound effects.

quality_dimensions.name: Noise Floor
quality_dimensions.description: Background noise must be below acceptable threshold.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: No audible hiss, hum, or digital artifacts in silent passages.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Persistent noise or artifacts audible at normal playback level.

quality_dimensions.name: Loudness Consistency
quality_dimensions.description: Perceived loudness must be consistent across scenes.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Loudness within +/- 2 LU of target across all scenes.

quality_dimensions.name: Dynamic Range
quality_dimensions.description: Audio must preserve appropriate dynamic range.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Quiet moments audible. Loud moments not clipped.
